title: Static-owner to heat-map non-identifiability witness
purpose: Show, with an exact Lean and independent Fraction witness, that pinned static inverse-covariance data do not select a unique production heat/root map when the generator, filtration, raw-current derivative and q-ledger are absent.

static_witness.interpretation: The inverse pair and diagonal contractions are a finite illustrative witness compatible with the pinned static data; neither diagonal map is asserted to be the A1 production dynamics.

source_scope.a1: Hash-pinned deterministic A1 functional/backend parameters; static functional data only.
source_scope.a7: Hash-pinned fixed-floor covariance-normal composite; static covariance data only.
source_scope.r136: Production raw-current spatial intertwiner and one-use q-ledger flags are explicitly false.
source_scope.r125: Production root-shell factorisation flag is explicitly false.
source_scope.r192: R-192 stops at the first missing production heat/root raw-current map.

hostile_mutations: replace the static inverse relation by a non-inverse pair
replace one diagonal contraction by an expansion or sign-changing map
make either map fail zero preservation
erase the reversed relative decay order
insert a heat generator or raw-current field into A1 or A7 and call it absent
promote the R-136 or R-125 false production flags to proved
insert a Lean sorry, admit, axiom or unsafe escape
boundary: This T0 claim-nonbearing witness proves only static-owner non-identifiability: two distinct positive zero-preserving diagonal contractions fit the same finite inverse-covariance data and reverse relative decay order, while the pinned A1/A7 authorities and R-136/R-125 flags supply no production heat/root map. It does not identify either map with A1 dynamics, prove a heat semigroup, q-ledger, root-shell factorisation, A13/T-050 closure, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty comparison, removal or continuum limit. A future gate-level proof requires a hash-pinned production generator/filtration/raw-current derivative/projector and one-use q-ledger before the R-192 owner order can be rerun. No new negative, tier change or PDF follows.
next_action: Supply and hash-pin the actual production generator, filtration, raw-current spatial derivative/projector and one-use q-ledger; then rerun R-192 unchanged and test whether the owner map is unique before attempting A13 gate closure.
no_overclaim: T0 claim-nonbearing interface audit only. The exact Lean witness and independent Fraction lane show non-identifiability of a production heat/root map from the registered static owners; they do not prove an A1 dynamical map, close A13 or T-050, or establish any physical, thermodynamic, removal or continuum result.
